rows.message: Please table the budget item at Friday's meeting.
rows.rewrite: Please add the budget item to Friday's agenda for discussion. The budget item remains active and scheduled for Friday.
rows.baseline_text: Please add the budget item to Friday's meeting agenda for discussion.

rows.message: Please send the signed form by 03/04.
rows.rewrite: Please send the signed form by 03/04. The date is written as day first then month.
rows.baseline_text: Please send the signed form by 3 April.

rows.message: Bring a plate to the team lunch on Friday.
rows.rewrite: Bring a plate to the team lunch on Friday.
rows.baseline_text: Please bring a dish of food to share at the team lunch on Friday.

rows.message: The meeting has been moved forward by two days.
rows.rewrite: The meeting has been moved forward by two days.
rows.baseline_text: The meeting is now two days earlier than planned.

rows.message: Our biweekly sync starts next week.
rows.rewrite: Our biweekly sync starts next week.
rows.baseline_text: Our sync every two weeks starts next week.

rows.message: Quite good work on the report; a few tweaks needed before it goes out.
rows.rewrite: I consider the report acceptable but it needs changes before it goes out.
rows.baseline_text: The report is acceptable but needs some changes before we send it.

rows.message: Timesheets are due by end of play on Friday.
rows.rewrite: Timesheets are due by Friday 5 pm.
rows.baseline_text: Timesheets are due by 5:00 PM on Friday.

rows.message: Invoices are payable within 30 days of the invoice date.
rows.rewrite: Invoices are payable within 30 days of the invoice date.
rows.baseline_text: Payment is due no later than 30 calendar days after the invoice date.

rows.message: Summarise the ticket and close it if it's resolved.
rows.rewrite: Summarise the ticket and close it if it is resolved. Resolved means the customer has confirmed the fix works.
rows.baseline_text: Summarise the ticket and close it only after the customer confirms the issue is fixed.

rows.message: Delete old files from the shared drive.
rows.rewrite: Delete old files from the shared drive.
rows.baseline_text: Delete files in the shared drive that have not been modified in over 12 months.

rows.message: Reply to customers quickly and keep it short.
rows.rewrite: Reply to each customer within one hour. Limit replies to a maximum of three sentences.
rows.baseline_text: Reply to every customer within one hour, using no more than three sentences.

rows.message: Escalate anything urgent to the on-call engineer.
rows.rewrite: Escalate anything urgent to the on-call engineer. Page the on-call engineer for urgent issues. Do not require separate logging for urgent issues that are paged. Urgent means a service is down or customer data is at risk.
rows.baseline_text: Page the on-call engineer only if a service is down or customer data is at risk. Log everything else.

rows.message: Don't email the client until legal has signed off, then send the update.
rows.rewrite: Do not email the client until legal gives written approval, then send the update.
rows.baseline_text: Do not email the client until the legal team gives written approval. Then send the update.
